name: Particle Data Group (LBNL-hosted Review of Particle Physics)
what_to_cost: compilation operations (staff + collaborators) through the 2024 edition; not the underlying experiments

name: KEGG (Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes)
BICEP2 / Keck Array / BICEP3 (South Pole CMB polarization)
what_to_cost: construction + operations through the 2021 BK18 result (excl. shared South Pole station costs, or state them)

name: ESO Very Large Telescope (incl. X-shooter)
what_to_cost: construction + operations to 2019, or a per-night share for the kilonova spectra

name: MESSENGER (NASA Mercury orbiter)
what_to_cost: mission lifecycle cost (development, launch, operations to 2015)

name: ALMA (Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array)
what_to_cost: construction + operations to 2015 (HL Tau long-baseline campaign)

name: Casgevy (exa-cel) development and clinical program (Vertex / CRISPR Therapeutics)
what_to_cost: R&D + clinical-trial spend to FDA approval, Dec 2023

name: Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope (GBM detected GRB 170817A)
MEG / MEG II (PSI, mu -> e gamma search)
MICROSCOPE (CNES equivalence-principle satellite)
what_to_cost: mission lifecycle cost to 2022 final result

name: NCBI (US National Center for Biotechnology Information)
what_to_cost: share of operations maintaining genetic-code tables; or note that the code itself was established by 1960s studies

name: NICER (ISS X-ray timing instrument)
what_to_cost: instrument + operations to date (neutron-star radius constraints)

name: NuSTAR (NASA hard X-ray telescope)
what_to_cost: mission lifecycle cost to 2014 (Cas A 44Ti map)

name: Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project
what_to_cost: project cost for the 2012 and 2025 landscape reports (grant totals)

name: UN World Urbanization Prospects (UN DESA Population Division; via World Bank WDI)
what_to_cost: compilation program operations; underlying national censuses are out of scope or costed separately

name: US Census Bureau Business Formation Statistics
what_to_cost: program operating cost to 2026 (small survey product)
